text: On that day, you will say:I give you thanks, O Lord;though you have been angry with me,your anger has abated, and you have consoled me.
God indeed is my salvation;I am confident and unafraid.For the Lord is my strength and my might,and he has been my salvation. [AA]
With joy you will draw waterfrom the fountains of salvation, [AB]
And you will say on that day:give thanks to the Lord, acclaim his name;Among the nations make known his deeds,proclaim how exalted is his name. [AC]
Sing praise to the Lord for he has done glorious things;let this be known throughout all the earth. [AD]
Shout with exultation, City of Zion,for great in your midstis the Holy One of Israel! [AE]
